plain_description.what: An earlier result found that the gemma embedder beats the qwen3 embedder at fine levels, but both were cut to 256 dimensions, which keeps only 6% of qwen3's size and 33% of gemma's. This test compares each embedder at several sizes on three intent datasets with known labels, choosing the size on one data part and reading the result once on another.
plain_description.why: It checks whether the 'gemma is better' finding is just an artefact of the size cut.
plain_description.information: If the edge vanished, the earlier finding would be an artefact. Result (no new calls): at each embedder's best size, gemma's edge survives on 2 of 3 datasets (MASSIVE and Banking77) and is a tie on CLINC. The size cut explains part of the edge, not all of it. Prompts were not controlled. A later check found that quantisation does not explain the edge (tested up to Q8 only). This makes 'gemma is better' a candidate for reopening, not a change of the embedder of record. Intent datasets only; nothing about MMLU-Pro.
